stories.title: Ewloe roundabout disruption to continue into mid-July, council confirms
stories.summary: Months of disruption at the Ewloe and St David’s roundabouts will continue into mid-July after Flintshire County Council confirmed an overrun on its active travel works programme. stories.title: Historic coal mine shafts force fresh changes to 300-home Hawarden development
stories.summary: A Hawarden councillor has demanded that the developer behind a 300-home Deeside housing site face the public over its latest plans, saying residents cannot understand what is being proposed. stories.title: Parents fury as Flintshire Council relaunches unchanged Catholic super-school plans
stories.summary: Parents who have spent 15 months campaigning to make their voices heard over Flintshire’s Catholic super-school plans have reacted with anger after the authority re-launched an unchanged proposal for consultation. stories.title: Police appeal for help finding missing 60-year-old woman from Pentre Halkyn
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for help to find a 60-year-old woman who has been missing from the Pentre Halkyn area since this morning. stories.title: Online harassment reports to North Wales Police up 135% in two years, FOI shows
stories.summary: Recorded cyber-enabled harassment offences in North Wales have more than doubled in two years, according to figures released by North Wales Police. The force recorded 1,514 such offences in 2025, up from 644 in 2023, an increase of 870 in two years. The 2024 figure was 1,155. The figures cover harassment offences flagged by officers
